eyebrow: Pre-creating a PV by hand doesn't scale

steps.label: Static
steps.sub: a human creates the PV ahead of time, every time

steps.label: StorageClass
steps.sub: a template describing how to create storage on demand

steps.label: Dynamic
steps.sub: a PVC triggers automatic PV creation, no manual step

eyebrow: StorageClass — a recipe, not real storage
code:
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: fast-ssd
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
parameters:
  type: gp3
  fsType: ext4
reclaimPolicy: Delete
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
caption: provisioner names the CSI driver that actually creates the disk when a PVC asks for it.

eyebrow: A PVC that provisions its own PV
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: catalog-db-pvc
spec:
  storageClassName: fast-ssd
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
caption: No PV exists yet — creating this PVC triggers the fast-ssd provisioner to build one automatically.
